inputs.text: An anime illustration, vertical composition, close-up upper body on a plain white background. A young woman with short dark blue-purple hair in a neat bob with blunt bangs leans down over a young man, her right hand resting gently on the top of his head. She wears a small white flower hair ornament with a gold tassel hanging on the left side of her hair, a crisp white long-sleeved dress shirt, a navy blue vest dress layered over it, a light blue ribbon tied in a bow at the collar, a single round gold button, and a dark navy square school badge with a gold emblem stitched on the chest. Her eyes are half-closed with a soft, warm, teasing smile, a light blush across her cheeks and tiny beads of sweat on her forehead and cheek, and she gazes down at him. Below her a young man with short black hair lies on his back, his head tilted up toward her, wearing a white collared shirt left open at the neck, blushing with small drops of sweat on his cheek and neck as he looks back up at her. Soft high-key diffused lighting with gentle shadows, delicate cel-shaded anime coloring, thin crisp linework, luminous skin with subtle airbrushed shading, clean flat white background, romantic and slightly teasing intimacy.
